description:
Currently under construction by a local builder, this four double bedroom detached family home is set to the southern edge of the highly regarded village. The property features a spacious living room and dining kitchen, along with a utility room and cloakroom W.C. Two of the bedrooms boast en-suites, with an additional family bathroom.

The property offers ample parking, a garden, and a private entrance, providing the perfect space for family gatherings and entertaining guests. The excellent quality of finish and high specification fittings throughout ensure a modern family home that combines style with functionality.

Located close to a primary school, public house, and village shop, this property offers easy access to a range of amenities. Excellent transport links to the city, M6 motorway, and A69 make it an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful yet well-connected lifestyle. Don't miss the opportunity to make this your new home - contact us today for more information.

Directions From the centre of Scotby, head south on Broomfallen Road. Go under the railway arch the development is located on the left-hand side after approximately 400 meters.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected and solar panels installed, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
